diff --git a/lib/keeper/keeper_tool_load_receipts.ml b/lib/keeper/keeper_tool_load_receipts.ml
index 81e92836de6..186dfdb1560 100644
--- a/lib/keeper/keeper_tool_load_receipts.ml
+++ b/lib/keeper/keeper_tool_load_receipts.ml
@@ -177,17 +177,29 @@ let source_to_json = function
 ;;
 
 let surface_digest surface =
-  `List
-    (List.map
-       (fun { source; schema } ->
-          `Assoc
-            [ "source", source_to_json source
-            ; "schema", Agent_core.Types.tool_schema_to_json schema
-            ])
-       surface)
-  |> Yojson.Safe.sort
-  |> Yojson.Safe.to_string
-  |> Digestif.SHA256.digest_string
+  Digestif.SHA256.digesti_string (fun emit ->
+    (* Same initial size as Yojson.Safe.to_string; owned by this one call. *)
+    let buffer = Buffer.create 256 in
+    let emit_entry { source; schema } =
+      `Assoc
+        [ "source", source_to_json source
+        ; "schema", Agent_core.Types.tool_schema_to_json schema
+        ]
+      |> Yojson.Safe.sort
+      |> Yojson.Safe.to_string ~buf:buffer
+      |> emit
+    in
+    let rec emit_entries = function
+      | [] -> ()
+      | [ entry ] -> emit_entry entry
+      | entry :: rest ->
+        emit_entry entry;
+        emit ",";
+        emit_entries rest
+    in
+    emit "[";
+    emit_entries surface;
+    emit "]")
 ;;
